description: This file defines the class 'Image_Canvas_PDF' for handling PDF output in the Image_Canvas package, including methods for drawing shapes, text, images, and managing PDF document properties.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
classes.description: A class extending Image_Canvas to generate PDF output using PDFlib, supporting drawing shapes, text, images, and PDF document management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDF canvas, setting page size, orientation, and starting a new PDF document or attaching to an existing one.

methods.name: _getX
methods.description: Converts relative x-coordinate to absolute position based on left offset.

methods.name: _getY
methods.description: Converts relative y-coordinate to absolute position based on page height and top offset.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Converts a color input to an RGB array scaled between 0 and 1 for PDFlib.

methods.name: _setLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style and width for drawing lines in the PDF.

methods.name: _setFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill color style for shapes in the PDF.

methods.name: _setFont
methods.description: Configures the font for text rendering, including font name, size, encoding, and color.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the graphics state of the PDF canvas.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional color.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon shape, optionally closed and filled.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle shape with optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle with optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape; implementation pending.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string in the current font.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the current font size.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text at specified position with alignment and color options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image at specified position with optional resizing and alignment.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the PDF document to the browser and closes the resource.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the PDF document to a file and closes the resource.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML link to the saved PDF file.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects the major version of PDFlib installed.
